description: This file is a shell script used for testing git checkout functionality. It includes test setup, execution, and verification functions for various scenarios related to git checkout, branch switching, and related git operations.

methods.name: do_checkout
methods.description: Performs a git checkout with specified options, branch, and optional object id, and verifies the checkout succeeded or failed as expected.

methods.name: test_dirty_unmergeable
methods.description: Tests that diff with unmergeable changes exits with code 1.

methods.name: test_dirty_unmergeable_discards_changes
methods.description: Checks that diff with unmergeable changes discards changes correctly.

methods.name: setup_dirty_unmergeable
methods.description: Sets up the test environment with unmergeable changes in files.

methods.name: test_dirty_mergeable
methods.description: Tests that diff with mergeable changes exits with code 1.

methods.name: test_dirty_mergeable_discards_changes
methods.description: Verifies that diff with mergeable changes discards changes correctly.

methods.name: setup_dirty_mergeable
methods.description: Sets up the environment with mergeable changes in files.
